whyItMatters: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore.
actions: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Directory.Build.props no longer carries a lockfile that can be rewritten by a plain restore.
